title: Nuclear Secrets and Taped Conversations: A Look at the Evidence Against Trump.

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Today, an indictment was unsealed.
sentences.zh: 今天，一份起诉书被解封了。

sentences.en: Charging Donald J.
sentences.zh: 指控唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump with felony violations of our national security laws as well as participating in a conspiracy to obstruct justice.
sentences.zh: 特朗普犯有违反国家安全法的重罪，并参与了妨碍司法的共谋。

sentences.en: On Friday, when the federal indictment of Donald Trump over his handling of classified materials
sentences.zh: 周五，当针对唐纳德·特朗普处理机密文件一事的联邦起诉书

sentences.en: was finally unsealed, we got a glimpse into just how strong the government's legal case against him will actually be.
sentences.zh: 最终解封时，我们得以一窥政府针对他的法律诉讼究竟有多强有力。

sentences.en: Our laws that protect national defense information are critical for the safety and security of the United States, and they must be enforced.
sentences.zh: 我们保护国防信息的法律对于美国的安全保障至关重要，必须得到执行。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Ben Protess, walks us through the evidence.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事本·普罗特斯将带我们梳理这些证据。

sentences.en: We have one set of laws in this country, and they apply to everyone.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，我们只有一套法律，而且适用于所有人。

sentences.en: Monday, June 12th.
sentences.zh: 6月12日，星期一。

sentences.en: Ben, I want to recap for you where we were as of Friday morning, which is when we published our last episode about all of this.
sentences.zh: 本，我想为你回顾一下周五上午的情况，也就是我们发布关于此事的上一期节目的时候。

sentences.en: At that point, we understood that Donald Trump had been indicted over his handling of classified
sentences.zh: 当时我们了解到，唐纳德·特朗普因处理机密

sentences.en: materials and that the charges involved obstructing the federal government's efforts to retrieve those documents.
sentences.zh: 文件而被起诉，且指控涉及妨碍联邦政府追回这些文件的努力。

sentences.en: But the indictment itself had not yet been made public.
sentences.zh: 但起诉书本身尚未公开。

sentences.en: So there was a lot we still didn't really understand.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还有很多情况并不真正了解。

sentences.en: So I wonder if you can pick up the story from there.
sentences.zh: 我想请你从那里接着讲起。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So on Friday, we actually get the indictment, the thing we've been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 周五我们终于拿到了起诉书，也就是我们一直等待的东西。

sentences.en: And it's a doozy.
sentences.zh: 而且内容非常惊人。

sentences.en: I mean, we've got 37 counts laid out in 49 pages.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，49页的文件中列出了37项指控。

sentences.en: Many of the counts relate to his willful retention of the documents.
sentences.zh: 许多指控与他蓄意保留这些文件有关。

sentences.en: He actually removed them from the White House.
sentences.zh: 他实际上把它们从白宫带走了。

sentences.en: And then several of the counts relate to his refusal to return them or his obstruction of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 还有几项指控与他拒绝归还文件或妨碍调查有关。

sentences.en: And the indictment just sort of lays out the evidence, much of it seemingly pretty damning in this great detail.
sentences.zh: 起诉书以极大的细节列出了证据，其中许多看起来相当确凿。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about all that detail.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这些细节。

sentences.en: And I think we should organize it in a few different ways, given what we already know about the case.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们已经了解的情况，我认为我们应该从几个不同的角度来梳理它。

sentences.en: So let's talk about the indictment in terms of, first, what does it tell us about the nature of these classified materials that Trump took, which has always been a little bit
sentences.zh: 首先，我们从起诉书的内容谈起，它告诉我们特朗普带走的这些机密材料的性质是什么，这一直以来都是一个

sentences.en: of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 小谜团。

sentences.en: And then second, what we learned about exactly how and where Trump stored these classified materials during this period where he wouldn't return them.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们了解到特朗普在拒绝归还文件的这段时间里，究竟是如何以及在哪里存放这些机密材料的。

sentences.en: And third, the specific ways the indictment alleges that he tried to obstruct the government from ever getting the documents back.
sentences.zh: 第三，起诉书指控他试图通过哪些具体方式妨碍政府追回这些文件。

sentences.en: All right, let's bite these off one at a time, Michael.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克尔，我们一个一个来拆解。

sentences.en: So the indictment says that when he leaves the White House, he takes documents related to some of our nation's most important agencies.
sentences.zh: 起诉书称，他离开白宫时，带走了与我国一些最重要的机构相关的文件。

sentences.en: So we're talking the CIA, NSA, State Department, Defense, and some of the documents that are in
sentences.zh: 我们指的是中情局、国安局、国务院、国防部，起诉书中引用的他带走的

sentences.en: the indictment that are cited that he took, these are things related to the military capabilities of a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 一些文件，涉及外国的军事能力。

sentences.en: One document that relates to the nuclear capability of a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 其中一份文件涉及外国的核能力。

sentences.en: One document concerned the military contingency planning of the United States, and yet another concerned nuclear weaponry of the United States.
sentences.zh: 一份文件涉及美国的军事应急计划，另一份则涉及美国的核武器。

sentences.en: I mean, I just want to linger on one of the documents you just mentioned, Ben, nuclear weaponry of the United States.
sentences.zh: 本，我想就你刚才提到的其中一份文件多说几句，即美国的核武器。

sentences.en: Donald Trump took a document from the White House that in some way or another detailed the
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普从白宫带走了一份以某种方式详细记录了

sentences.en: United States' nuclear capacities.
sentences.zh: 美国核能力的文档。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And these are documents that, according to the indictment, left the White House and went down to Florida with him.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，这些文件离开了白宫，并随他一起去了佛罗里达。

sentences.en: And listen, the former president and his supporters have tried to portray this as, you know, just a few innocent documents.
sentences.zh: 听着，这位前总统及其支持者试图将其描绘成，你知道，只是几份无辜的文件。

sentences.en: They're his documents.
sentences.zh: 那是他的文件。

sentences.en: He had the right to do this and nothing to see here.
sentences.zh: 他有权这样做，没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: But that's just not the case, at least not as it's laid out in the indictment.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此，至少起诉书里不是这么写的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in no way is this the story of Trump taking a set of kind of harmless mementos, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这绝不是特朗普带走了一些无害纪念品的故事，对吧？

sentences.en: Like a personal letter from, you know, the prime minister of a foreign country or some treaty he signed that later became public.
sentences.zh: 比如一封来自外国总理的私人信件，或者他签署的后来公开的某项条约。

sentences.en: Like you're saying, just kind of almost incomprehensibly top secret stuff.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，这简直是不可思议的绝密材料。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So I think, Ben, this quite naturally brings us to the second category of information in
sentences.zh: 本，我认为这很自然地引出了起诉书中信息的第二个类别，

sentences.en: the indictment, which is what it tells us about how Trump treated these ultra sensitive documents, given what the contents of them are.
sentences.zh: 即考虑到这些文件的内容，它告诉我们特朗普是如何对待这些超敏感文件的。

sentences.en: So what exactly does the indictment tell us about that?
sentences.zh: 那么起诉书对此究竟说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it tells us that he was pretty careless with where he put him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它告诉我们，他在存放这些文件时非常粗心。

sentences.en: So picture yourself walking into former president's club, Mar-a-Lago, down in Florida, and you see boxes and boxes of documents.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你走进这位前总统的俱乐部——佛罗里达州的马阿拉歌庄园，你看到了成堆成堆的文件箱。

sentences.en: Now, some of them are kept in a storage room.
sentences.zh: 现在，其中一些存放在储藏室里。

sentences.en: Some of these boxes, though, were not.
sentences.zh: 但有些箱子却并非如此。

sentences.en: They were in a ballroom, a bathroom, a shower, even.
sentences.zh: 它们甚至被放在宴会厅、浴室、淋浴间里。

sentences.en: A shower.
sentences.zh: 淋浴间？

sentences.en: A shower.
sentences.zh: 淋浴间。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Remember, these are top secret documents, right?
sentences.zh: 记住，这些可是绝密文件，对吧？

sentences.en: But what the indictment shows is that they're kind of just put in random places without any real security.
sentences.zh: 但起诉书显示，它们就像被随意丢在某个地方，没有任何真正的安全保障。

sentences.en: And in the indictment, you can see that Trump's aides are texting each other back and forth.
sentences.zh: 在起诉书中，你可以看到特朗普的助手们在互相发短信。

sentences.en: What do we do with these documents?
sentences.zh: 我们该拿这些文件怎么办？

sentences.en: At one point, you've got one employee writing to another.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一名员工写信给另一名员工。

sentences.en: There's still a little room left in the shower where the other stuff is.
sentences.zh: 放其他东西的淋浴间里还有一点空间。

sentences.en: I think there was just so little, according to the indictment, so little care given to where to store these records that they were just sort of everywhere all across Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，我认为他们对这些记录的存放极其不重视，以至于它们在马阿拉歌庄园随处可见。

sentences.en: So these aides, they're just treating them as the president's stuff and therefore putting
sentences.zh: 所以这些助手只是把它们当作总统的杂物，因此把它们

sentences.en: them wherever they find space, including some very strange places to put classified documents like a bathroom, a shower, a ballroom stage.
sentences.zh: 放在任何有空间的地方，包括一些存放机密文件非常奇怪的地方，比如浴室、淋浴间、宴会厅舞台。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what the indictment tells us is that he didn't just keep them in strange places.
sentences.zh: 起诉书还告诉我们，他不仅把它们放在奇怪的地方。

sentences.en: He also shared them in some strange ways as well.
sentences.zh: 他还以一些奇怪的方式分享了它们。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: So there are two potentially alarming examples that the indictment recites.
sentences.zh: 起诉书中列举了两个潜在的令人震惊的例子。

sentences.en: The first is when Trump shared a highly sensitive, quote unquote, plan of attack against Iran to visitors at his golf club in Bedminster.
sentences.zh: 第一个是特朗普在贝德明斯特的高尔夫俱乐部向访客分享了一份所谓的针对伊朗的“高度敏感攻击计划”。

sentences.en: This is in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 这在新泽西州。

sentences.en: And this is happening back in July of 2021.
sentences.zh: 这发生在2021年7月。

sentences.en: So he takes documents from Mar-a-Lago to another Trump club, this time in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 所以他把文件从马阿拉歌带到了另一个特朗普俱乐部，这次是在新泽西州。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Packed him up, put him on the plane, and flew to Bedminster and is at his club and is being interviewed for a book.
sentences.zh: 打包带上飞机，飞到贝德明斯特，在俱乐部里接受一本书的采访。

sentences.en: And so there's a recording that's going on here.
sentences.zh: 当时正在进行录音。

sentences.en: It's on tape, and the investigators have this recording, and they have Trump in his own words describing a document that he has as highly confidential and, in his words, secret.
sentences.zh: 这有录音带，调查人员掌握了这段录音，录音中特朗普亲口描述他手中的一份文件为“高度机密”，用他的话说，是“秘密的”。

sentences.en: Now, what's really notable here is that he admits that he could have declassified it when he
sentences.zh: 这里真正值得注意的是，他承认如果他在任时可以将其解密，

sentences.en: was president, but that he didn't, and that this was secret information that was now being shared.
sentences.zh: 但他没有这样做，而现在这些秘密信息被分享出去了。

sentences.en: And you can kind of hear, apparently, on the tape, according to the indictment, one of his aides in the background saying something to the effect of, oh, no, now we have a problem.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，你似乎可以在录音中听到他的一名助手在背景中说了一些类似“哦不，现在我们有麻烦了”的话。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: So you get from this tape very clear evidence that Trump, and it sounds like an aide close
sentences.zh: 所以从这段录音中，你可以得到非常明确的证据，证明特朗普，以及听起来在他身边的一名助手，

sentences.en: by, both understand that showing this document to the people in this room at Bedminster is
sentences.zh: 都明白向贝德明斯特房间里的人展示这份文件是

sentences.en: illegal because they don't have the right credentials, the right clearance to see this stuff.
sentences.zh: 违法的，因为他们没有查看这些材料所需的适当凭证和许可。

sentences.en: Certainly that's the case that's made in the indictment, and I'm always hesitant to say
sentences.zh: 起诉书中确实是这样主张的，我总是对断言他是否知道这是违法的持谨慎态度，但起诉书所呈现的无疑是在确立他对法律的认知。

sentences.en: what he knew was illegal or didn't know was illegal, but certainly what the indictment is laying out there is you're establishing his knowledge of the law.
sentences.zh: 他一直以来的核心辩护之一是，哦，我已经把它们解密了。

sentences.en: One of his central defenses all along is that, oh, I declassified these.
sentences.zh: 这些文件是我的。

sentences.en: These documents were mine.
sentences.zh: 我把它们解密了。

sentences.en: I declassified them.
sentences.zh: 但你确实有他亲口录音说，不，我没有解密这个，我本可以解密的。

sentences.en: But you have them literally on tape saying, no, I didn't declassify this, and I could have.
sentences.zh: 我不是评判什么是“确凿证据”的人，但我敢打赌检察官们认为那段录音已经是最接近确凿证据的东西了。

sentences.en: And I'm not one to judge what a smoking gun is, but I bet prosecutors feel that that recording is as close as you're going to get.
sentences.zh: 本，特朗普以一种相当令人震惊的方式向他人展示机密文件的第二个例子是什么？

sentences.en: Ben, what's the second example of Trump showing a classified document to someone in a way that feels pretty alarming?
sentences.zh: 他还与他政治行动委员会（PAC）的一名工作人员分享了一份绝密地图，一份军事地图。

sentences.en: So he also shared a top secret map, a military map with a staff member at his political action committee, his PAC.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，那个人没有安全许可。

sentences.en: And that person, according to the indictment, did not have a security clearance.
sentences.zh: 起诉书描述了特朗普如何很快意识到也许他不该展示这些，并告诉那个人，等等，不，别靠太近。

sentences.en: And so it sort of describes how Trump quickly realizes that maybe he shouldn't have been displaying that, and he tells this person, wait, no, don't get too close.
sentences.zh: 本，这份起诉书是否暗示了为什么特朗普会分享这些带有绝密信息的机密文件，尽管他在这两起案例中似乎都知道他不应该这样做？

sentences.en: Ben, does this indictment at all hint at why Trump would share these highly classified documents
sentences.zh: 还是说我们只能猜测，这样做是为了满足特朗普众所周知的炫耀欲望，并享受他所拥有的权力和获取信息的渠道以及重要性？

sentences.en: with super secret information, despite knowing, as he appeared to know in both cases, that he shouldn't?
sentences.zh: 起诉书不需要深入探讨动机，但在与我们的一些同事，特别是玛吉·哈伯曼讨论时，

sentences.en: Or are we kind of just left to speculate that doing this scratches a pretty well-known Trump
sentences.zh: 确实存在你所指出的那种他想要炫耀并感到自己很重要的欲望。

sentences.en: itch for showing things off and kind of relishing in the power and access and importance he has?
sentences.zh: 他刚刚受挫并输掉了选举。

sentences.en: So the indictment need not get into the motive, but in talking this over with some of our colleagues,
sentences.zh: 你知道，拥有这些文件肯定让他感到强大和重要。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman especially, there's definitely that itch that you noted correctly that he has to show off and to feel important.
sentences.zh: 但他有时还需要满足另一种欲望，对吧，那就是清算旧账。

sentences.en: He had just been burned and lost the election.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，他在贝德明斯特挥舞的那份伊朗文件，他们录下了他谈论它的内容。

sentences.en: You know, having these documents surely made him feel powerful and important.
sentences.zh: 在那里，特朗普在心中与一位前高级官员马克·米利陷入了争执。

sentences.en: But there's another itch that he has to scratch sometimes, right, which is settling old scores.
sentences.zh: 米利因为制衡特朗普，并可能阻止他攻击伊朗和其他国家而获得了大量正面报道。

sentences.en: So take, for instance, the Iran document that he was waving around at Bedminster and that they recorded him talking about.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: What you have there is Trump was locked in this feud in his mind with a former high-level official, Mark Milley.
sentences.zh: 特朗普觉得这份文件——我猜他声称这是米利针对伊朗的攻击计划——将为他平反，并用他自己的话说，根据录音，起诉书中也提到了，这将证明他的观点。

sentences.en: And Milley was getting all this good press for being a check on Trump and, you know, potentially saving him from attacking Iran and other countries.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这当然是在满足虚荣心，但这些文件在他看来也有能力帮助他清算旧账并击退敌人。

sentences.en: And Trump was seething.
sentences.zh: 所以，在特朗普看来，拿出一份高度机密的文件并向房间里的人展示，只是为了胜过某人、清算旧账、证明自己是对的另一种方式，就像他处理桌上任何文件时可能会做的那样。

sentences.en: And Trump felt like this document, which I guess sort of claimed was Milley's attack plan
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，这些恰好是你不应该那样做的文件。

sentences.en: against Iran, was going to exonerate Trump and was going to be, in his own words, according to the recording, it's in the indictment, was going to prove his case for him.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so, yes, certainly it's the ego stroking, but there's also that ability for some of these documents in his mind to sort of help him settle old scores and beat back his enemies.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们谈论的这种行为——最初获取文件，考虑到它们的机密程度，以及向没有许可的人展示文件——对于特朗普在此案中面临的指控有多重要？

sentences.en: So, in Trump's mind, producing a highly classified document and being able to show it to someone
sentences.zh: 当然，这很重要。

sentences.en: in the room with him was just another way to get the best of someone, settle a score, prove he was right, the kind of thing he might do with any document on his desk.
sentences.zh: 但如果你通读这份起诉书，随着你深入阅读这份详尽的文件，你会感觉到这只是冰山一角。

sentences.en: But in this case, these happen to be the kind of documents that you're not supposed to do that with.
sentences.zh: 大部分指控是特朗普试图妨碍调查或拒绝归还文件。

sentences.en: Bingo.
sentences.zh: 所以你会感觉到政府认为，我们交谈过的一些专家也认为，这可能是起诉书中最为严重的部分。

sentences.en: But how important to the charges that have just been brought against Trump in this case is this behavior we're talking about, the original taking of the documents, given
sentences.zh: 掩盖真相。

sentences.en: how classified they are, and the showing of the documents to people who didn't have the clearance.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Sure, it's important.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: But if you read through the indictment as you keep going through this sweeping document, you sort of get the sense that it's just the tip of the iceberg.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一——《Connections》。

sentences.en: Much of what's alleged is Trump's effort to obstruct the investigation or refuse to return the documents.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: And so you get the sense that the government feels, and some of the experts we're talking to feel, that that is perhaps the most serious part of the indictment.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: The cover-up.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试着捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天都会制作《拼字蜜蜂》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So then let's turn to this question of obstruction.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们转向妨碍司法公正这个问题。

sentences.en: What does this indictment allege about Trump's efforts to hide these classified materials from the government once the government asks for them all back?
sentences.zh: 这份起诉书指控特朗普在政府要求归还所有机密材料后，采取了哪些手段来向政府隐瞒这些材料？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So if you think of it, it all sort of flows from the subpoena that he got back in May of last year, May of 2022.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，这一切其实都源于他去年五月，也就是2022年五月收到的那张传票。

sentences.en: And so he gets a subpoena from the FBI and Justice Department basically saying, we want you to turn over all these classified documents that you have.
sentences.zh: 他收到了联邦调查局和司法部的传票，基本上是说，我们要求你交出你所持有的所有机密文件。

sentences.en: Whatever you have, turn them over.
sentences.zh: 无论你有什么，都交出来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is already a point at which the government thinks, you haven't given us everything even
sentences.zh: 当时政府已经认为，尽管我们提出了要求，但你并没有交出所有东西，

sentences.en: though we've asked, so now we're giving you a subpoena, so you now have to turn things over.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在发给你传票，你必须把东西交出来。

sentences.en: That's what the subpoena means.
sentences.zh: 这就是传票的含义。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: The subpoena means they had just convened a grand jury beginning a criminal investigation,
sentences.zh: 传票意味着他们刚刚召集了一个大陪审团，开始进行刑事调查，

sentences.en: and so now they're going to make a good faith attempt to recover the documents via subpoena.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在要通过传票，做出善意的尝试来追回这些文件。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what does the indictment say happens once this subpoena arrives?
sentences.zh: 那么起诉书上说，传票送达后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So instead of just turning them over, he first meets his lawyer, his new lawyer, a person by the name of Evan Corcoran, and Mr. Corcoran goes down to Mar-a-Lago, and right off the
sentences.zh: 所以他没有直接交出文件，而是先见了律师，他的新律师，一个名叫埃文·科科伦的人。科科伦先生去了海湖庄园，一见面，

sentences.en: bat, Trump says to him, I just don't really feel the need to comply with this subpoena, in essence.
sentences.zh: 特朗普就对他表示，本质上，他并不觉得有必要遵守这张传票。

sentences.en: So he says things like, I don't want anybody looking.
sentences.zh: 所以他说了一些话，比如，我不希望任何人查看。

sentences.en: I don't want anybody looking through my boxes.
sentences.zh: 我不希望任何人翻看我的箱子。

sentences.en: I really don't.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想。

sentences.en: I don't even want you looking through my boxes.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不想让你翻看我的箱子。

sentences.en: And then he sort of suggests things to Mr. Corcoran, his attorney, things like, what happens if we just don't respond at all, or just don't play ball with them?
sentences.zh: 然后他向他的律师科科伦先生暗示了一些事情，比如，如果我们根本不回应，或者干脆不配合他们会怎样？

sentences.en: And then he asked the question, wouldn't it be better if we just told him we didn't have anything here?
sentences.zh: 接着他问了一个问题，如果我们直接告诉他们我们这里什么都没有，会不会更好？

sentences.en: Which is sure, except that that's illegal.
sentences.zh: 这当然可以，但问题是那是违法的。

sentences.en: You have to respond to a lawful grand jury subpoena.
sentences.zh: 你必须回应合法的大陪审团传票。

sentences.en: You can either comply with it, or you can move to quash it, but you can't just tell the government a lie that you don't have anything there.
sentences.zh: 你要么遵守，要么申请撤销，但你不能直接对政府撒谎说你那里什么都没有。

sentences.en: So Trump realizes his lawyer will comply with the subpoena, and is going to turn over any
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普意识到他的律师会遵守传票，并打算交出任何

sentences.en: to the indictment, Trump directs his employee, Walt Nada, who's also charged in the indictment
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，特朗普指示他的员工沃尔特·诺塔（他也被起诉为同谋），

sentences.en: as a co-conspirator, to move boxes out of the storage room where Corcoran was just about to look.
sentences.zh: 将箱子从科科伦即将检查的储藏室里移走。

sentences.en: So in the days and the weeks leading up to Corcoran's visit to search for those documents,
sentences.zh: 所以在科科伦去搜查那些文件的几天和几周前，

sentences.en: Trump directs Nada to move these boxes.
sentences.zh: 特朗普指示诺塔转移这些箱子。

sentences.en: And we're not just talking about one or two boxes.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不仅仅是一两个箱子。

sentences.en: Ultimately, it's 64 boxes that Nada moves out.
sentences.zh: 最终，诺塔移走了64个箱子。

sentences.en: So despite all the moving of those boxes, Mr. Corcoran does still find about 38 documents that have classified markings.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管转移了那些箱子，科科伦先生还是发现了大约38份带有机密标记的文件。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Now, Mr. Corcoran doesn't have security clearance to hold on to them or to view them, really.
sentences.zh: 现在，科科伦先生并没有持有或查看这些文件的安全许可。

sentences.en: So Trump sort of suggests he take them back to his hotel room.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普暗示他把文件带回酒店房间。

sentences.en: And this is one of the more bizarre parts of the indictment.
sentences.zh: 这是起诉书中比较离奇的部分之一。

sentences.en: According to Mr. Corcoran, Mr. Trump makes a sort of a plucking gesture.
sentences.zh: 据科科伦先生说，特朗普做了一个类似“摘取”的手势。

sentences.en: If you can sort of imagine your hand dipping into a document and like plucking it out of a box, which Mr. Corcoran says is sort of like, well, OK, why don't you take him back
sentences.zh: 如果你能想象一下你的手伸进文件里，像从盒子里摘东西一样把它拿出来，科科伦先生说这就像是，好吧，你为什么不把它们带回

sentences.en: to your hotel room?
sentences.zh: 你的酒店房间呢？

sentences.en: And if there's anything sort of really bad in there, you know, sort of just just pluck it out.
sentences.zh: 如果里面有什么真的很糟糕的东西，你知道，就把它摘出来。

sentences.en: That's the that's the motion he made.
sentences.zh: 那就是他做的动作。

sentences.en: Just just sort of pluck it out.
sentences.zh: 就把它摘出来。

sentences.en: So I just want to make sure I'm understanding this.
sentences.zh: 我想确认一下我是否理解正确。

sentences.en: Trump has already hidden key classified documents from this lawyer.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已经向他的律师隐瞒了关键的机密文件。

sentences.en: But when the lawyer eventually does find some limited number of documents that are classified
sentences.zh: 但当律师最终确实发现了一些有限的机密文件，

sentences.en: and talks to Trump about it, Trump goes further and says, I want you to go through those classified documents and pluck out anything that seems like a problem for me legally.
sentences.zh: 并与特朗普谈论此事时，特朗普更进一步说，我希望你检查那些机密文件，把任何对我法律上不利的东西摘出来。

sentences.en: And then you can turn over what's left to the government.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以把剩下的交给政府。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so you can't just pluck out bad or incriminating information in response to a subpoena.
sentences.zh: 所以你不能为了回应传票，就随意摘除那些糟糕或有罪的证据。

sentences.en: You have to turn over everything.
sentences.zh: 你必须全部交出来。

sentences.en: And that's why it's such an important part of the indictment.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它是起诉书中如此重要的部分。

sentences.en: OK, and then what should we make of the fact that the lawyer in this case clearly has offered testimony against his client?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我们该如何看待本案律师显然已经提供了针对其客户的证词这一事实？

sentences.en: That would seem to be how we know that these conversations occurred.
sentences.zh: 这似乎就是我们得知这些对话发生的原因。

sentences.en: Usually they would be covered by attorney-client privilege, right?
sentences.zh: 通常这些对话应该受到律师-客户特权保护，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a great question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: So what happened is the government early this year decided to make an argument that they were able to see Mr. Corcoran's notes and to be able to secure the testimony from Mr.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，政府今年早些时候决定提出一个论点，即他们有权查看科科伦先生的笔记，并获得科科伦先生的证词，

sentences.en: Corcoran, even though it was covered normally by attorney-client privilege.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些通常受到律师-客户特权的保护。

sentences.en: And that's because there is a notable exception to attorney-client privilege, which is the crime fraud exception.
sentences.zh: 这是因为律师-客户特权有一个显著的例外，即“犯罪-欺诈例外”。

sentences.en: And basically what that means is if a client is using his or her lawyer to further a crime and the government can make a showing of that, then prosecutors can absolutely pierce the
sentences.zh: 基本上这意味着，如果客户利用他或她的律师来推进犯罪，并且政府能够证明这一点，那么检察官绝对可以打破这种

sentences.en: privilege.
sentences.zh: 特权。

sentences.en: If a judge agrees, in this case, sure enough, a judge agreed that Mr. Trump was trying to use Mr. Corcoran to further his crime, that allowed them to access these notes that Mr.
sentences.zh: 如果法官同意，在本案中，法官确实同意特朗普先生试图利用科科伦先生来推进他的犯罪，这使他们能够获取科科伦先生所做的笔记，并最终获得他的证词。

sentences.en: Corcoran made and ultimately secure his testimony as well.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So according to the indictment, what happens next in this alleged scheme to obstruct the government's retrieval of these documents?
sentences.zh: 那么根据起诉书，在这一所谓的妨碍政府追回文件的计划中，接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So what happens after Mr.
sentences.zh: 在科科伦先生提交了这38份额外文件之后，

sentences.en: Corcoran produces these 38 additional documents is the government has reason to believe that that's not it.
sentences.zh: 政府有理由相信事情还没结束。

sentences.en: And so they actually get surveillance footage of the property of Mar-a-Lago and they see
sentences.zh: 于是他们获取了海湖庄园的监控录像，他们看到

sentences.en: that people are moving boxes in and out and they start interviewing witnesses and they figure
sentences.zh: 人们在搬运箱子，他们开始采访证人，并弄清楚了

sentences.en: out absolutely things were moved in and out and perhaps it was just a drop in the bucket what had already been turned over.
sentences.zh: 确实有东西被搬进搬出，而且之前交出的那些可能只是冰山一角。

sentences.en: And so they ultimately go to a judge and get a warrant to search Mar-a-Lago last AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最终去找法官，并在去年八月获得了搜查海湖庄园的搜查令。

sentences.en: And there's this sort of extraordinary scene of former president's private residence being searched by a team of FBI agents.
sentences.zh: 出现了前总统私人住宅被联邦调查局特工小组搜查的非凡场景。

sentences.en: And this is sort of what alerted the world that this was not just some back and forth or discussion about documents, but a real live serious criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 这让全世界意识到，这不仅仅是关于文件的来回讨论，而是一场真正严肃的刑事调查。

sentences.en: And at that search, they sure enough find over 100 additional classified documents.
sentences.zh: 在这次搜查中，他们确实又发现了100多份额外的机密文件。

sentences.en: So Ben, this FBI search, which we all watched more or less in real time, it was a huge event.
sentences.zh: 本，这次联邦调查局的搜查，我们几乎是实时观看的，这是一个巨大的事件。

sentences.en: And it's kind of the culmination of this scheme that, according to the indictment, Trump has been up to.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，这可以说是特朗普一直在策划的阴谋的顶点。

sentences.en: He has hidden documents from his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他向他的律师隐瞒了文件。

sentences.en: He has asked his lawyer to pluck things out.
sentences.zh: 他要求他的律师摘除某些东西。

sentences.en: He has asked an aide to move boxes and hide things from his lawyer and the government.
sentences.zh: 他要求助手搬运箱子，并向他的律师和政府隐瞒东西。

sentences.en: And when the government shows up in this raid and starts looking around, what it finds is the, in some ways, successful for Trump result of all that scheming.
sentences.zh: 当政府在这次突袭中出现并开始四处搜查时，他们发现的，在某种程度上，是特朗普所有阴谋的“成果”。

sentences.en: He has kept dozens and dozens of classified documents.
sentences.zh: 他保留了数十份机密文件。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Ben, the volume and the strength of the evidence that you have just gone through and that is contained in this indictment, it feels very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 本，你刚才梳理的以及起诉书中包含的证据的数量和力度，感觉非常重要。

sentences.en: So do legal experts that you and our colleagues have been talking to, do they see this as a strong case?
sentences.zh: 那么，你和我们的同事一直在交谈的法律专家们，他们认为这是一个强有力的案件吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So most of the experts we're talking to would say that this is a very comprehensive indictment.
sentences.zh: 我们交谈的大多数专家都会说，这是一份非常全面的起诉书。

sentences.en: It establishes in their minds his knowledge of the law and that he had retained these documents
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，它确立了他对法律的了解，以及他保留了这些文件

sentences.en: and tried to obstruct the investigation, that there's a tremendous amount of evidence, both from documents, witness interviews, tapes.
sentences.zh: 并试图妨碍调查的事实，而且有大量的证据，包括文件、证人访谈和录音。

sentences.en: So while no case is perfect, I think a lot of the experts' reactions to this indictment is that it's pretty strong.
sentences.zh: 所以虽然没有完美的案件，但我认为许多专家对这份起诉书的反应是，它非常强有力。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And Ben, do we have any sense of what Trump's defense might look like yet?
sentences.zh: 本，我们对特朗普的辩护方向有什么了解吗？

sentences.en: Well, originally his defense was that he had declassified these documents and that they were his documents.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最初他的辩护是说他已经将这些文件解密了，而且这些是他的文件。

sentences.en: Obviously, that's going to be undermined by the recording they have of him at Bedminster.
sentences.zh: 显然，这一点会被他们在贝德明斯特录下的录音所削弱。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: We're going to learn, I'm sure, in the coming weeks and months what his substantive legal defense is going to be.
sentences.zh: 我相信在接下来的几周和几个月里，我们会了解到他实质性的法律辩护是什么。

sentences.en: And he recently just switched legal teams in this case.
sentences.zh: 而且他最近刚刚更换了本案的法律团队。

sentences.en: So we don't quite know just yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在还不太清楚。

sentences.en: But rhetorically, his defense is going to be that this is a continuation of the witch hunt from previous impeachments, that it's all the Democrats that are trying to get him,
sentences.zh: 但在修辞上，他的辩护将是，这是之前弹劾案中“猎巫行动”的延续，基本上是民主党人在试图对付他，

sentences.en: basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上是这样。

sentences.en: So is it fair to say that this case is looking like it very well could result in a conviction?
sentences.zh: 那么，说这个案件很有可能导致定罪，公平吗？

sentences.en: Well, not so faSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，别那么快下结论。

sentences.en: I think there are a lot of variables in a criminal proceeding.
sentences.zh: 我认为刑事诉讼中有很多变量。

sentences.en: And one of the things that's really important to keep in mind is whose courtroom the case will be in.
sentences.zh: 其中一件非常重要的事情是，案件将在谁的法庭上审理。

sentences.en: And in this case, it's going to be in the courtroom of Judge Aileen Cannon.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，它将在艾琳·坎农法官的法庭上审理。

sentences.en: And Judge Cannon was not only appointed by President Trump, but also she had ruled in his favor in a related matter in this document's case last year.
sentences.zh: 坎农法官不仅是由特朗普总统任命的，而且她在去年此案的相关事项中也做出了对他有利的裁决。

sentences.en: And so at one point in this case, she effectively froze a portion of the government's investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个案件的某个阶段，她实际上冻结了政府调查的一部分。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那件事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She sort of barred prosecutors from using the materials they had seized from Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 她禁止检察官使用他们从海湖庄园查获的材料。

sentences.en: And she ultimately was overturned by the appeals court.
sentences.zh: 她最终被上诉法院推翻了。

sentences.en: But this was a big contentious matter.
sentences.zh: 但这曾是一个引起巨大争议的问题。

sentences.en: And she showed some sympathy to the former president's case.
sentences.zh: 而且她对前总统的案件表现出了一些同情。

sentences.en: So I think we just don't know yet how it's going to play out in her courtroom.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们还不知道在她的法庭上会如何发展。

sentences.en: Ben, can the Department of Justice seek a different judge based on the impression that she is a Trump ally?
sentences.zh: 本，司法部能否基于她被认为是特朗普盟友的印象，申请更换法官？

sentences.en: Do we know if that's even possible or something that they're contemplating?
sentences.zh: 我们知道这是否可能，或者他们是否在考虑这样做吗？

sentences.en: Well, actually, Michael, Jack Smith and his team made the decision to file this in the
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，迈克尔，杰克·史密斯和他的团队决定在

sentences.en: Southern District of Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达南区提起诉讼。

sentences.en: That was their choice.
sentences.zh: 这是他们的选择。

sentences.en: And in fact, everybody originally expected they were going to file it in Washington.
sentences.zh: 事实上，每个人最初都以为他们会在华盛顿提起诉讼。

sentences.en: The grand jury had been sitting in Washington for almost a year.
sentences.zh: 大陪审团已经在华盛顿坐镇了近一年。

sentences.en: And all of that frenzy and flurry of investigative activity was in Washington.
sentences.zh: 所有那些疯狂的调查活动也都在华盛顿。

sentences.en: And then out of nowhere, a few weeks ago, the activities sort of shifted to Florida.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，几周前，活动转移到了佛罗里达。

sentences.en: And presumably, the government felt they had to do that because so much of the alleged misconduct that's in the indictment occurred in Florida.
sentences.zh: 据推测，政府认为他们必须这样做，因为起诉书中指控的许多不当行为都发生在佛罗里达。

sentences.en: And so they knew the risks of filing it down there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们知道在那里提起诉讼的风险。

sentences.en: And also, you could view it from their perspective of this case is so bulletproof that we don't mind trying in front of a judge who's been skeptical of us in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你可以从他们的角度来看，这个案件是如此无懈可击，以至于我们不介意在一位过去对我们持怀疑态度的法官面前审理。

sentences.en: But obviously, we just have to sort of see it play out.
sentences.zh: 但显然，我们只能拭目以待。

sentences.en: Now, you also have to keep in mind that the jury pool down there is going to be a little different than if they had filed it in Washington.
sentences.zh: 现在，你还必须记住，那里的陪审团成员与他们在华盛顿提起诉讼时会有所不同。

sentences.en: In Washington, you tend to get people who are government workers, people who are a little more sympathetic to the prosecution's viewpoint, broadly speaking.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，你往往会得到政府工作人员，也就是那些从广义上讲对检方观点更具同情心的人。

sentences.en: And generally speaking, you're going to have Democrats who are not huge supporters of the former president.
sentences.zh: 而且总的来说，你会有那些不太支持前总统的民主党人。

sentences.en: Down in Florida, obviously, a state he won twice, is a very different jury pool.
sentences.zh: 而在佛罗里达，显然，这是一个他赢过两次的州，陪审团成员的情况非常不同。

sentences.en: So all it takes is one juror in that more skeptical jury pool to balk and you have a hung jury.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那个更具怀疑态度的陪审团中，只要有一个陪审员阻挠，你就会得到一个悬案陪审团。

sentences.en: And the government would have to either forego its case or try it again entirely new.
sentences.zh: 政府要么放弃案件，要么完全重新审理。

sentences.en: So that is the potential wildcard in all of this is who's sitting on the jury and the judge who's overseeing the trial.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是所有这些事情中的潜在变数，即谁在陪审团中，以及谁在监督审判的法官。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Ben, that makes me think of the other Trump indictment that you have been covering.
sentences.zh: 本，这让我想起了你一直在报道的另一个特朗普起诉案。

sentences.en: You're now covering two.
sentences.zh: 你现在在报道两个。

sentences.en: And the first one was an indictment brought in Manhattan against Trump for falsifying business records in an alleged hush money scheme.
sentences.zh: 第一个是在曼哈顿对特朗普提起的起诉，罪名是在所谓的封口费计划中伪造商业记录。

sentences.en: And there, the widely held view is that the jury pool is unlikely to be sympathetic to
sentences.zh: 在那里，普遍的观点是陪审团不太可能对

sentences.en: Trump, we think.
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示同情，我们认为。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you could almost view these as sort of the inverse of each other.
sentences.zh: 所以你几乎可以把这两个案件看作是彼此的倒影。

sentences.en: So in Manhattan, you have a very sympathetic jury pool and a judge overseeing the case that has appeared pretty skeptical of Trump in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 在曼哈顿，陪审团对特朗普非常同情，而负责此案的法官过去也表现出对特朗普相当怀疑的态度。

sentences.en: But you don't quite have that national security level of import of the case.
sentences.zh: 但这个案子并没有达到国家安全层面的重要性。

sentences.en: And that's not to undermine the significance of the hush money case.
sentences.zh: 这并不是要削弱封口费案的重要性。

sentences.en: It's just not at the national security level.
sentences.zh: 它只是没达到国家安全那个级别。

sentences.en: In the special counsel's indictment that we are now reviewing, you have perhaps a more skeptical jury pool and a more skeptical judge.
sentences.zh: 在我们现在审阅的特别检察官起诉书中，陪审团和法官可能都更加怀疑他。

sentences.en: But you have this sort of heavy weight of a national security indictment.
sentences.zh: 但你面对的是国家安全起诉书这种沉重的分量。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So arguably, the indictment that carries the national security implications and that feels like this heavier, weightier indictment could actually be the one that's a little tougher
sentences.zh: 所以可以说，这份涉及国家安全影响、感觉更沉重、分量更足的起诉书，实际上可能更难

sentences.en: to prove with that jury pool.
sentences.zh: 在那个陪审团面前证明。

sentences.en: But you could also see in the middle of the election next year, two different trials, both of which he's potentially convicted in.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以预见，在明年大选期间，他可能会面临两场不同的审判，且都有可能被定罪。

sentences.en: And he could be facing some very serious prison time from both.
sentences.zh: 而且他可能面临两案并罚带来的非常严重的监禁刑期。

sentences.en: Well, Ben, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，本，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 他们想动用所谓的《间谍法》。

sentences.zh: 听起来是不是很可怕？

sentences.en: latest indictment against him, as well as the special counsel who carried out the investigation at the heart of it, Jack Smith.
sentences.zh: 针对他的最新起诉书，以及负责调查此案核心的特别检察官杰克·史密斯。

sentences.en: Deranged Jack Smith.
sentences.zh: 精神错乱的杰克·史密斯。

sentences.zh: 我昨天看着他走上去讲话。

sentences.zh: 他讲了大约两分半钟。

sentences.zh: 他在发抖。

sentences.en: He was so scared.
sentences.zh: 他太害怕了。

sentences.en: He didn't want to be there.
sentences.zh: 他根本不想待在那里。

sentences.en: In what is likely to be a major theme of his presidential campaign, Trump told his supporters that the indictment was not about him, but about them.
sentences.zh: 特朗普告诉支持者，起诉书针对的不是他，而是他们，这很可能成为他总统竞选的一个主要议题。

sentences.en: Because in the end, they're not coming after me.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，他们不是冲着我来的。

sentences.en: They're coming after you.
sentences.zh: 他们是冲着你们来的。

sentences.en: And I'm just standing in their way.
sentences.zh: 而我只是挡在他们面前。

sentences.en: Here I am.
sentences.zh: 我就在这里。

sentences.zh: 我挡在他们面前。

sentences.zh: 特朗普定于明天下午在坎农法官的迈阿密法庭接受传讯。
